question: Koliko ima filmova u bazi?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film

question: Koliko ima glumaca?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM actor

question: Koliko ima kupaca?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer

question: Koliko razlicitih jezika postoji u bazi?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM language

question: Koji filmovi traju duze od 180 minuta? Prikazi naziv.
gold_sql: SELECT title FROM film WHERE length > 180

question: Koliko filmova ima ocenu 'R'?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film WHERE rating = 'R'

question: Koliko filmova ima cenu iznajmljivanja vecu od 4?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film WHERE rental_rate > 4

question: Prikazi ime i prezime kupaca cije prezime pocinje na slovo 'B'.
gold_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM customer WHERE last_name LIKE 'B%'

question: Koliko filmova ima trajanje izmedju 60 i 90 minuta?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film WHERE length BETWEEN 60 AND 90

question: Koja je prosecna duzina filma?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(length) FROM film

question: Koliki je ukupan prihod od svih placanja?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM payment

question: Koja je najveca, a koja najmanja cena iznajmljivanja filma?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(rental_rate), MIN(rental_rate) FROM film

question: Koliko filmova ima u svakoj kategoriji? Prikazi kategoriju i broj.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON fc.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.name

question: Koliko kupaca je registrovano u svakoj prodavnici? Prikazi store_id i broj.
gold_sql: SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) FROM customer GROUP BY store_id

question: Kojih pet filmova je najduze? Prikazi naziv i duzinu.
gold_sql: SELECT title, length FROM film ORDER BY length DESC, title ASC LIMIT 5

question: Koji glumac glumi u najvise filmova? Prikazi ime, prezime i broj filmova.
gold_sql: SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name, COUNT(*) AS broj FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id GROUP BY a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name ORDER BY broj DESC LIMIT 1

question: Kojih pet kategorija ima najvise filmova? Prikazi kategoriju i broj.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS broj FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON fc.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY broj DESC LIMIT 5

question: Koji kupac je potrosio najvise novca? Prikazi ime, prezime i ukupan iznos.
gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(p.amount) AS ukupno FROM customer c JOIN payment p ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY ukupno DESC LIMIT 1

question: Iz koje drzave ima najvise kupaca? Prikazi drzavu i broj.
gold_sql: SELECT co.country, COUNT(*) AS broj FROM customer cu JOIN address a ON a.address_id = cu.address_id JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id = a.city_id JOIN country co ON co.country_id = ci.country_id GROUP BY co.country ORDER BY broj DESC LIMIT 1

question: Kojih pet kupaca je obavilo najvise iznajmljivanja? Prikazi ime, prezime i broj.
gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(*) AS broj FROM customer c JOIN rental r ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY broj DESC LIMIT 5

question: Koje filmove glumi glumac sa imenom 'NICK' i prezimenom 'WAHLBERG'? Prikazi nazive.
gold_sql: SELECT f.title FROM film f JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.film_id = f.film_id JOIN actor a ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id WHERE a.first_name = 'NICK' AND a.last_name = 'WAHLBERG'

question: Prikazi naziv filma i njegovu kategoriju, za prvih 10 filmova abecedno.
gold_sql: SELECT f.title, c.name FROM film f JOIN film_category fc ON fc.film_id = f.film_id JOIN category c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id ORDER BY f.title ASC LIMIT 10

question: Koliko filmova je u inventaru svake prodavnice? Prikazi store_id i broj.
gold_sql: SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS broj FROM inventory GROUP BY store_id

question: Koliko filmova je u kategoriji 'Comedy'?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film f JOIN film_category fc ON fc.film_id = f.film_id JOIN category c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Comedy'
